claims.text: The available filings report on Petroliam Nasional Berhad (PETRONAS Group), not PETRONAS Chemicals Group (PCG) as a standalone entity.

No subsidiary-level financials or operational details specific to PETRONAS Chemicals Group (PCG) are disclosed in the retrieved filings; all figures and commentary pertain to the PETRONAS Group as a whole.

The PETRONAS Group filings include group-level financials such as revenue, EBITDA, PAT, cash flows, capital investments, total assets, and shareholders’ equity, but do not break out figures for PETRONAS Chemicals Group (PCG).
Warnings in the filings explicitly state that the reports are for PETRONAS Group and not for PETRONAS Chemicals Group (PCG), and should not be treated as filings of PCG.
